svg.aria-label: EvidentlyAEO, founding engineer since 2025: answers from seven AI assistants are collected daily, scored by an LLM and stored in Postgres, then feed dashboards, a grounded content engine and a 29-tool MCP server.
svg.title: EvidentlyAEO, founding engineer since 2025: answers from seven AI assistants are collected daily, scored by an LLM and stored in Postgres, then feed dashboards, a grounded content engine and a 29-tool MCP server.
svg.text: Shows brands how they come up when buyers ask AI assistants about their category, and what to fix.
From the first commit to paying customers in under a year.
